report:
Reviewed meta.reviews.staleness against its complete claim, the sole ordinary implementation association in review.rs, and the complete three-test associated set. Captured the review specification for the explicitly referenced freshness, association, output, and decision contracts, and the complete review test file for Fixture/constants and integration context. No TODO/N/A evidence exists.

Implementation: acceptable checks anchor identity, schema/policy versions, complete nonblank output without edits, and inputs_match. read_summary checks persisted identity and supported versions, and load_saved only loads output for a completed recording. inventory includes complete claim text, whole associated implementation files, full annotated test bodies, and deterministic implementation/test metadata without source positions. input_errors compares current initial fragments and association metadata and reselects every additional fragment using exact text equality. Thus changed claim/code/tests, association changes, missing/ambiguous selections, and changed captured dependencies invalidate reuse. Selectors for claims/tests carry identity rather than position, so unchanged text moved by unrelated edits remains reusable. source_lines split/join retains blank lines and trailing newlines; whole-file equality therefore invalidates any file text edit. record rejects outdated input rather than substituting current text. No implementation defect was identified.

Complete associated set: complete_claim_blocks_are_selected_but_unrelated_movement_is_not_stale asserts full multi-paragraph/list/table/code claim content, acceptance after unrelated movement/outside edits, and rejection after edits in each selected block. test_selector_preserves_metadata_and_ignores_unrelated_line_movement asserts test identity/inherited cfg/full selected text, accepts unrelated movement, and rejects cfg changes. unsupported_versions_and_mismatched_identity_cannot_pass rejects saved records separately for schema_version, policy_version, and anchor mismatches, asserting the specific diagnostic. The latter existing test received a staleness association in this review, followed by formatting and a fresh start.

The claim explicitly incorporates the independent fragment_freshness, fragment_associations, output_format, and decisions contracts. Captured existing integration assertions support those incorporated guarantees without duplicating their annotations here: added_or_removed_associations_invalidate_unchanged_saved_fragments covers test-set and implementation-association changes; whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits covers exact whole-file/additional-fragment changes; another_anchors_test_read_tracks_body_and_identity covers changed/missing/ambiguous test context; invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review and completed_corrupt_records_and_invalid_layout_cannot_pass cover incomplete/invalid outputs, changed implementation input, and requested edits. Their concrete assertions plus shared equality/resolver implementation account for blank-line and test-body freshness without redundant new scenarios. Historical approval was independently reassessed against the reorganized current tests.

Execution is separate from source judgment: I ran review start/read, cargo fmt, and review record; I did not run test suites or build. The coordinator separately reports 331 functional tests, 31 review tests, and root build passing. The only Rust change was the test association attribute; coordinator will include it in the batch verification and delegated quality/sanity reviews. Initial recording rejected changed captured test context; fresh start captured the final annotations and I checked those changes before this assessment. No implementation or test-body changes were made.
